claim: Minimal reproducer for a wide-destination scoreboard hazard: ds_read_b128 into v[0:3] returns CORRECT raw data (verified by storing v0..v3 directly: exactly [d0,d1,d2,d3] per row), but a dependent instruction a few cycles later (a v_cndmask dword-select chain over v1..v3) reads STALE register contents, while consumers further downstream (the global stores of the same registers) read the FRESH values. The busy-clear for the wide destination therefore releases consumers BEFORE all four destination registers are committed, or the consumer-side readiness path (RegisterFileCache bypass in VectorRegisterFile::operandsReady) skips the not-yet-written registers. This is the first concrete hazard reproducing the CK attention symptom shape: tile data loaded via ds_read_b128 (192 per kernel) feeding nearby MFMA consumers reads stale tile fragments, losing exactly those head-dim slices while narrow (b32/b64) paths and far consumers stay correct. Reproducer: tools/mfma_isa_test/lds_b128d.hip + tools/qwen35_lds_race_capsule.py (v6-raw result: raw v[0:3] all correct, selected dword wrong on 256/256 lanes).
fix_targets: completion/unmark path for multi-register LDS destinations (LMP completion -> completeAcc -> vdstK.write -> unmark ordering)
consistency between dispatchInstruction busy-marking (covers physIndices) and the unmark site (coverage unknown)
